measures: Whether the resume evidences taking a system to production and staying responsible for it after launch.
source: Criteria drafted for ticket 05 against the category 04 defined and the 6/6 evidence 02 recorded (inventory.md sections 1 and 4).

criteria.name: destination
criteria.question: Does any bullet say the work reached somewhere real -- production, a release, live traffic, users, customers?
criteria.yes_requires: A quote naming where the work ended up. Building it, designing it, or researching it is not a destination.
criteria.no_looks_like: Every bullet stops at the artifact: 'Built a classifier', 'Designed a pipeline', 'Explored transformer architectures'.

criteria.name: named system
criteria.place_question: Does THIS bullet name a shipped system specifically enough to ask about in an interview -- or refer back to one named that way in another bullet of the same role?
criteria.question: Is at least one shipped thing named specifically enough to ask about in an interview?
criteria.yes_requires: A name specific enough that an interviewer could say 'tell me about X' and both know which system -- 'the forecasting service', 'the claims assistant', 'the retrieval pipeline', vLLM, Llama-3-8B, the eval harness -- named in the same bullet as the destination, or elsewhere in the same role.
criteria.no_looks_like: A bare category noun -- 'the pipeline', 'the service', 'the system', 'the model' -- or a name that only appears in the skills section or a different role. 'Shipped AI-powered solutions', 'delivered scalable systems' -- portable to any candidate.

criteria.name: operational fact
criteria.place_question: Does THIS bullet state a fact that could only be true after the system ran for real?
criteria.question: Does any bullet state a fact that could only be true after the system ran for real?
criteria.yes_requires: Load carried, users served, an incident, an outage, on-call, uptime, an SLA or SLO, a regression caught in production, or that the system is still in use or still running -- that it survived is itself an operational fact.
criteria.no_looks_like: Only pre-launch numbers -- offline accuracy, a benchmark score, a model size.

criteria.name: post-launch work
criteria.place_question: Does THIS bullet describe work done to a system that was already live?
criteria.question: Does any bullet describe work done to a system that was already live?
criteria.yes_requires: Operating, monitoring, debugging, tuning, migrating, porting, replacing, profiling or iterating on something already running -- as opposed to work that ended at release. Staying is not work: 'stayed on afterwards' with no task named does not count, and neither does 'still in use' or 'is still running' -- that says the system survived, not what the candidate did to it.
criteria.no_looks_like: Every bullet ends at the launch. Nothing describes what happened to the system afterwards -- including a bare 'stayed on' with no work named, or 'still in use' / 'is still running' on its own.

criteria.name: first-person ownership
criteria.question: Is the shipped work attributed to this candidate rather than to a team, and without hedging their part?
criteria.yes_requires: The destination bullet's subject is the candidate. 'Owned', 'Shipped', 'Cut', 'Built' -- an act, not a contribution to one.
criteria.no_looks_like: 'We shipped', 'the team launched', 'helped deliver', 'contributed to', 'assisted with', 'participated in', 'supported the rollout'.

bands.label: E
bands.name: No destination
bands.reads: Nothing in the resume says any work reached anywhere.

bands.label: D
bands.name: Built, not operated
bands.rule: C1 met, and either C2 unmet or neither C3 nor C4 met
bands.reads: Something shipped, but it is unnameable, or nothing says it ran or that the candidate stayed with it.

bands.label: C
bands.name: Shipped
bands.rule: C1 and C2 met, and exactly one of C3, C4
bands.reads: A named thing reached production, and there is one half of the after-launch story.

bands.label: B
bands.name: Shipped and operated
bands.rule: C1, C2, C3 and C4 met, C5 unmet
bands.reads: The full arc is evidenced, but the resume attributes it to a team or hedges the candidate's part.

bands.label: A
bands.name: Owned in production
bands.reads: This person took a named system to production, it ran, they stayed with it, and the resume says it was them.
